source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Even after this **TRANSPORT** has made an [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), units can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from it. A unit that does so is treated as if it made a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in that phase. It cannot declare a charge that turn, but is otherwise unrestricted.
